title: Coinbase Launches U.S. Spot Margin Trading With Up to 10x Leverage
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches U.S. Spot Margin Trading With Up to 10x Leverage Coinbase opened crypto spot margin trading in the U.S. with up to 10x leverage, but only for eligible contract participants with more than $10 million invested. This post Coinbase Launches U.S. Spot Margin Trading With Up to 10x Leverage first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
